changes: p1 name normalized to Saccidānandanāthatīrtha (saṃcid- read as corruption of sacc-); confidence lowered to medium
p1 role changed from 'teacher' to 'other': he is the author's guru, not a teacher connected with this copy
p1 residence corrected from 'Parvvata' to 'Śrīparvata' (śrī is part of the toponym in śrīparvatavāsinaḥ, not an honorific)

notes: This is only the author's colophon of the Tantradīpikā (pūjājapahomavidhi section), followed by a gāyatrīmudrā passage. The colophon names no scribe, patron, date or place of copying. 'siḍyasya' is a corruption of 'śiṣyasya'. 'saṃcidānanda' is most likely a corruption of 'saccidānanda'. Saccidānandanāthatīrtha appears only as the author's guru. He resided at Śrīparvata, possibly Śrīśaila. The catalogue fields are empty.
